sourceFacts: Published receipt hex() requires exactly64 lowercase hex characters and indexedCoins applies it to indexed owner.
At retained indexer image-label revision, UnshieldedUtxo conversion encodes owner using network-specific Unshielded Bech32m; token type and intent hash remain hex.
Installed public-data-provider transform preserves owner verbatim and converts only value to BigInt.

Installed wallet address-format package is3.1.2; UnshieldedAddress enforces32 bytes. MidnightBech32m.parse splits HRP into three destructured segments, so exact re-encoding is required to reject extra suffix segments.

sqlite.query: SELECT lower(hex(u.owner)) AS ownerHex, length(u.owner) AS ownerBytes, lower(hex(u.token_type)) AS tokenType, lower(hex(u.intent_hash)) AS intentHash, u.output_index AS outputNo FROM unshielded_utxos u JOIN transactions t ON u.creating_transaction_id=t.id WHERE lower(hex(t.hash))=?
